name.purpose: The name in the opening only, beside a black square.

number.purpose: Step numbers in how a shoot runs.

marquee.purpose: The moving band between the opening and the work.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing for every reveal and hover: quick start, long settle, no overshoot.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: Delay per step (--i) between neighbours in a reveal.

motion.name: reveal-rise
motion.purpose: Text and small blocks rising into place.

motion.name: reveal-wipe
motion.purpose: Photographs uncovered from the top down.

motion.name: reveal-grow
motion.purpose: The opening's column lines drawn down.

motion.name: reveal-pop
motion.purpose: The black square beside the name.

motion.name: reveal-line
motion.purpose: Section hairlines drawn from the start of the line.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: The only continuous motion; paused on hover.

motion.name: photo-hover
motion.purpose: A slow push in on hover, pointer devices only.

components.name: Section head
components.description: Opens every section: light title, small count, hairline drawn underneath.
components.css: .ds-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; padding: 24px 16px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #000; background: #F2F2F2; color: #000; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-head-title { margin: 0; font-size: 32px; line-height: 40px; font-weight: 300; } .ds-head-count { font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; }

components.name: Photo stand-in
components.description: A fixed-ratio frame; grey until its photograph is uploaded, marked with its ratio.
components.css: .ds-photo { position: relative; width: 180px; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; overflow: hidden; background: #E3E3E3; border-radius: 0; } .ds-photo-mark { position: absolute; bottom: 6px; inset-inline-end: 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; line-height: 14px; color: #5E5E5E; }

components.name: Call-to-action row
components.description: Two cells split by a hairline; the link cell fills with ink on hover and its arrow nudges forward.
components.html:
[سطر قصير]

اطلب تصويرًا
components.css: .ds-cta { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; width: 360px; border-top: 1px solid #000; border-bottom: 1px solid #000; background: #F2F2F2; color: #000; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; } .ds-cta-line { margin: 0; padding: 13px 16px; border-inline-end: 1px solid #000; } .ds-cta-link { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-cta-link svg { transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-cta-link:hover, .ds-cta-link:focus-visible { background: #000; color: #F2F2F2; } .ds-cta-link:hover svg { transform: translateX(-6px); } .ds-cta-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Contact link
components.description: Large text link whose 1px underline is redrawn from the start of the line on hover.
components.css: .ds-contact { display: inline-block; padding-block: 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; line-height: 28px; color: #000; text-decoration: none; background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) right bottom 6px / 100% 1px no-repeat; } .ds-contact:hover { animation: ds-redraw 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-contact:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #000; outline-offset: 4px; } @keyframes ds-redraw { from { background-size: 0 1px; } }

components.description: The 44px header and footer bars: name with a black square, what the page is, a link or the year.

narrative.overview:
The page reads like a photographer's contact sheet laid on a light table: frames in ruled columns, small labels beside them, the work in order, and nothing that competes with the photographs. Structure is drawn, not boxed: black 1px hairlines divide the page into columns and rows, column lines run the full height of their block, and the grey ground lets white-background packshots sit in it like prints. It draws on obys agency's grid and gallery sites and on Frame & Form, adapted for a phone held upright.

Density is calm: small type for labels and descriptions, very large light type for the few things that should be remembered (the name, the closing invitation, the step numbers, the marquee). There is no colour in the interface; colour comes only from the photographs. The one black band is the cinematography section, where the same system is redrawn in reverse.

Motion grammar: things arrive as they scroll into view and then stay still. Hairlines are drawn from the start of the line, column lines grow down from the top, photographs are uncovered from the top down like a print coming out, text rises a short way into place, staggered 80ms behind its neighbour, all on one long-settling ease. The marquee band is the only thing that keeps moving. Nothing bounces, flashes or glows, and every motion is off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Confirmed rejections: rounded corners, colourful palettes, glowing elements, shadows, sideways-scrolling sections, and anything from the portfolio's look.
keyCharacteristics: Light grey ground, black hairlines, greys only.
One typeface (IBM Plex Sans Arabic) in light, regular and medium.
Sharp corners everywhere; black squares as the only mark.
Full-height column lines; a staggered two-column gallery on phones, four columns wide.
Scroll-in reveals and one slow marquee; nothing loops except the marquee.

rules.name: The Greys Only Rule
rules.body: The interface has no hue. No accent colour, no tinted greys, no coloured links or buttons; colour on the page comes only from the photographs.

rules.name: The One Dark Band Rule
rules.body: Black ground appears once, for cinematography, by redefining the same tokens (`.dark`); no other section switches to dark.

rules.name: The Light Voice Rule
rules.body: Large type is never bold. Headlines, numbers and the name use weight 300 or 400; 500 is reserved for small titles that need to hold their own beside a label.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats above the page. If something needs separating, draw a 1px line.

dos: **Do** keep every corner at 0 and every divider a 1px line in `line`.
**Do** draw column lines as full-height 1px backgrounds on the grid, not as borders on cells.
**Do** keep text short and in `content.ts`; components hold no copy.
**Do** design at phone width first and only scroll down.
**Do** use logical properties (`inset-inline-start`, `border-inline-end`) and `dir="ltr"` on Latin details.
**Do** add motion only through the reveal types in `visuals.css` (`rise`, `wipe`, `grow`, `pop`, `line`, `data-lines`), staggered with `--i`, on `--ease`.
**Do** keep content visible without scripts and without motion (`html.js` and `prefers-reduced-motion` guard every hidden state).
donts: **Don't** add any hue to the interface: no accent colour, gradients of colour, or coloured text.
**Don't** use rounded corners, shadows, glows or blur.
**Don't** add sideways-scrolling rows, carousels or sliders.
**Don't** use bouncing, elastic or looping motion other than the marquee.
**Don't** add a second page or a navigation menu.
**Don't** borrow anything from the portfolio: its colour worlds, candy toys, confetti, sun gradients, DM Sans or Readex Pro.
